hero.eyebrow: AI receptionist for home service businesses
hero.headlineControl1: Every missed call is a lost job.
hero.sub: Sarah is an AI voice receptionist for plumbers, HVAC, electrical and roofing companies. She answers every call, captures the job and puts it on your schedule, day or night.
hero.visualLabel: Example of a call answered by Sarah
hero.callerLine: “Hi, my water heater is leaking all over the garage.”
hero.sarahLine: “I’m sorry to hear that. I’m marking this as an emergency and finding you a time right now. Can I confirm your address?”

trust.heading: Works with the tools you already use
trust.note: Integrations connect through each provider’s own sign-in. Price-book connectors import your pricing; they do not sync jobs.

problem.title: Missed calls are missed money
problem.lead: A homeowner with a leaking pipe won’t wait for a callback. They call the next company on the list.

items.pain: You’re on a roof or under a sink when the phone rings.
items.fix: Sarah answers, asks the right questions and books the job.

items.pain: Nights and weekends go to voicemail, which is when emergencies happen.
items.fix: Sarah picks up around the clock and flags urgent calls as they come in.

items.pain: Details from phone calls get lost before they reach a quote or an invoice.
items.fix: Every call becomes a record: summary, job and customer history in one place.

calculatorCta: Estimate what missed calls cost your business

how.title: Up and running in three steps

steps.title: Forward your number
steps.body: Keep the number your customers already know and forward calls to Sarah. You can stop forwarding whenever you like.

steps.title: Sarah answers every call
steps.body: She greets the caller, asks what’s wrong, flags emergencies and collects the name, address and job details in a natural conversation.

steps.title: You get a job, not a voicemail
steps.body: Each call becomes a summary and a booked or pending job, and the caller gets a text so they know what happens next.

items.title: Texts and follow-ups
items.body: Confirmations, reminders and follow-up messages go out on their own so customers always know what happens next.

items.title: Email that sends itself
items.body: Quotes, invoices and receipts reach your customers by email without anyone retyping them.

items.title: Review requests
items.body: Ask happy customers for a review right after the job, while the visit is still fresh in their mind.

items.title: Repeat business
items.body: Remind customers about maintenance and service anniversaries so the next job comes to you.

items.title: Campaigns
items.body: Reach past customers with a seasonal offer, using the customer list Vireek already keeps.

items.title: Photo-backed work
items.body: Attach job photos to the record so the work is documented when it’s time to invoice.

items.title: Transcripts and summaries
items.body: Every call gets a summary, and paid plans keep the transcript, so you can see exactly what was said.

showcase.title: From the first ring to the final invoice
showcase.lead: Vireek connects the phone, the schedule and the money, so nothing falls between tools.

blocks.title: Every call answered, every job captured
blocks.body: Sarah picks up each call, works out what the caller needs and records it as a job. No hold music, no voicemail tag.
bullets: Names, addresses and job details captured

blocks.title: A schedule that fills itself
blocks.body: Booked jobs land on your board with the details your technicians need before they arrive.

blocks.title: Quotes and invoices without the paperwork

blocks.body: Know how many calls came in, how many turned into jobs and where revenue slips away.

proof.title: Try Sarah on your own calls
proof.lead: Forward your line, see how Sarah handles real callers and decide from your own results. There is no long-term contract.
proof.securityTitle: How we protect your business and your customers

securityItems.title: Isolated accounts
securityItems.body: Your data lives in your own account and is kept separate from every other business with row-level security.

securityItems.title: Encrypted in transit and at rest
securityItems.body: Connections use TLS and stored data is encrypted at rest.

securityItems.title: Audit trail
securityItems.body: Sensitive actions are written to an audit log so you can see who did what and when.

securityItems.title: Payments through Stripe
securityItems.body: Card details go straight to Stripe. Vireek never stores full card numbers.

securityItems.title: Upfront about AI
securityItems.body: Sarah tells callers she is an AI at the start of the call.

final.title: Stop losing jobs to voicemail
final.call: Or call Sarah and hear her for yourself
